name: Seat or slot grid
use_when: fixed spots people claim: car seats, tables, beds, shifts, time slots, tickets in a block
'who's riding with who', 'call your seat', 'sign up for a slot'
two people must not get the same spot
dont_use_when: things to bring or do (use claims)
finding a time everyone can make (use overlap)
guarantees: one seat per person when set; taking a new seat frees the old one
the first claim on a seat wins, the second is a no-op
a leaver's seats open up again; a late joiner can take any open seat

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'Who's riding with who?'

name.description: Car, table or shift name, e.g. "Maya's car"

onePerPerson.description: true if each person takes one spot
